title: Dispute with opposition candidate Emmanuel Bichot over 'Muslim Brotherhood' accusations
description: During the 2026 campaign, opposition councillor and candidate Emmanuel Bichot sent a letter to Dijon residents accusing the municipality of maintaining 'worrying links with the Islamist Muslim Brotherhood movement'. In a 27 February 2026 statement, Koenders categorically rejected the allegations as 'calumnious', denounced an 'unworthy instrumentalisation' of the campaign and reserved the right to file a defamation complaint after the election. The accusations are an opposition claim that she denies; presumption of innocence applies.

title: Criticism from La France insoumise over support for extended municipal police powers
description: On 11 February 2026 the Dijon Populaire collective, affiliated with La France insoumise in Cote-d'Or, publicly criticised Koenders for backing a Senate bill to extend municipal police prerogatives, calling it a 'securitarian flight forward' that ignores the root causes of insecurity, and citing the metropole's OnDijon videosurveillance contract with Capgemini.

title: Withdrawal of Fabien Robert's animal-protection delegation over RN contact
description: Two weeks before the March 2026 vote, Koenders withdrew the animal-protection delegation from majority councillor Fabien Robert after he met a National Rally / UDR-RN candidate to discuss animal welfare. She framed any contact with the far right as a 'red line'; Robert said his cross-party dialogue had been 'manipulated' and denied any ideological rapprochement. The episode exposed tensions inside her outgoing majority.
